_note: E X O (RC Demo A), 512K / 32 banks. Worked out with the toolkit.
_trampoline: Inter-bank calls go through f31:$FC0F. The caller pushes a synthetic
return frame, loads the target bank into A, and JMPs there; the
trampoline does STA $8000 to switch, restores X, and RTSes into the
newly-banked code. A recursive-descent tracer cannot follow that: the
destination only exists on the stack, which it does not model. Each such
landing site therefore has to be declared here by hand.
f31:$FC16 is the matching return path -- it pulls the caller's bank back
off the stack, so it restores rather than selects.

headers.f31:$FC0F:
Bank trampoline. A = target bank; the caller has already
pushed the return address the RTS below will use.
headers.f31:$FC16: The way back: the caller's bank was pushed, so pull and restore it.
